title: SG-8.2.3 Block submit and disable Send at zero quota
summary: When remaining quota is 0 the contribution sheet blocks submit, disables Send and explains why
description: Context: ContributionSheet derives `remaining` from MAX_PER_PLAYER minus sent entries and shows 'Contributions left: n', but nothing stops a submit at 0. Desired behavior: at remaining 0 the Send button is disabled, submit is blocked, and an inline message 'You have used all your suggestions this round' is shown. Expected result: the player cannot send past the quota and knows why. Why: avoids guaranteed 409 errors from the backend.
acceptance_criteria: Given remaining quota is 0 When the sheet renders Then the text 'You have used all your suggestions this round' is visible
Given remaining quota is 0 When the sheet renders Then the Send button is disabled
Given remaining quota is 0 When the form is submitted Then submitContribution is not called
Given remaining quota is above 0 When the sheet renders Then Send is enabled and no quota message is shown

in_scope: ContributionSheet quota message, disabled Send, submit guard

technical_constraints: Use existing MAX_PER_PLAYER and `remaining` value; no new API
definition_of_done: Both requirements implemented and verified by unit tests
non_functional: Message is exposed with role=alert for assistive tech
